summary.zh-CN: 上传岗位需求与简历即可开始：JD 草案、简历初筛对照清单、面试纲要与面试记录汇总；只出草案与对照，不做录用或淘汰决定，不用受保护特征筛人。
summary.en: Start from job requirements and resumes: JD drafts, resume screening checklists, interview guides and note summaries; drafts and comparisons only, never hire or reject decisions, never screening on protected characteristics.

now.zh-CN: 把用人部门需求拆成职责、必备与加分条件，每条附来源，缺口标待确认
now.en: Split hiring requirements into responsibilities, must-haves and nice-to-haves, each sourced, with gaps flagged

now.zh-CN: 逐份简历对照 JD 条目，只记满足、未满足、未提及、疑似满足并附出处，不打分不排名
now.en: Compare each resume against JD items, recording only met, not met, not mentioned or possibly met with citations; no scores or ranking

now.zh-CN: 设计面试纲要与评分表，每题对应一条能力要求，评分锚点是可观察行为，自动排除禁问事项
now.en: Design interview guides and scorecards where every question maps to a competency, anchors are observable behaviors and prohibited questions are excluded

now.zh-CN: 从面试转写提取事实、面试官原话评价与待办，多位面试官评价并列不合并
now.en: Extract facts, verbatim interviewer comments and action items from transcripts, keeping multiple interviewers' comments side by side

needs.zh-CN: 岗位需求说明或旧版 JD、简历、面试转写或面试官笔记
needs.en: Job requirement notes or a previous JD, resumes, interview transcripts or interviewer notes

needs.zh-CN: 岗位名称、面试轮次与目标，以及经验折算等补充口径
needs.en: Job title, interview round and goals, plus supplementary rules such as how internships count

needs.zh-CN: 进入下一轮、录用与薪酬决定由你与用人部门作出
needs.en: Advancing, hiring and compensation decisions stay with you and the hiring team

permissions.zh-CN: 只读取你本次提供的文件，不检索候选人的社交账号或外部资料
permissions.en: Reads only the files you provide; never searches candidates' social accounts or external sources

permissions.zh-CN: 需你确认才会做：向候选人或第三方发送材料、写入招聘系统或人才库、创建面试日程、起草录用通知或拒信
permissions.en: Only with your confirmation: sending material to candidates or third parties, writing to recruiting systems or talent pools, creating interview schedules, drafting offer or rejection letters

permissions.zh-CN: 候选人个人信息最小化：不摘录身份证号、联系方式、照片等与筛选无关的字段
permissions.en: Candidate data is kept to the minimum: ID numbers, contact details, photos and other non-essential fields are not extracted

conditions.zh-CN: 2026-09-25 已用真实模型（DeepSeek deepseek-flash，隔离的测试环境）验证：JD 起草、简历初筛对照、面试纲要与记录三个模板按合成样例产出结构与期望一致，年龄、婚育等受保护特征被剔除并在合规提示中说明，只出对照清单与草案、不给录用或淘汰结论。
conditions.en: Verified with a real model (DeepSeek deepseek-flash, isolated test environment) on 2026-09-25: JD draft, resume screening checklist and interview guide with notes matched the expected structure on synthetic samples; protected attributes such as age and marital status were excluded and flagged; only checklists and drafts, no hire or reject conclusions.

conditions.zh-CN: 飞书、钉钉等日历与消息连接为可选项，本版不内置。
conditions.en: Lark, DingTalk and other calendar or messaging connections are optional and not bundled in this version.

conditions.zh-CN: 招聘协作员只出草案与对照清单；录用、淘汰、薪酬决定由你作出，筛选不使用受保护特征。
conditions.en: The role produces drafts and checklists only; hire, reject and compensation decisions are yours, and screening never uses protected characteristics.
